name: spec-truth
body: The target-truth content of a durable spec statement: what is, or what needs to become true. A superseded statement is updated or removed, never annotated; a `note` deepens the understanding of what is and never records what was. Materializing a source spec or reconciling to an implementation rewrites the nodes to the present truth and leaves no provenance trail — git history, not the spec, describes what was.
